examples.title: Sunburst
examples.description: Sixty spokes in seven colours radiate from the middle of the screen, drawn with LINE in the QL's eight-colour MODE 8.

examples.title: Mirror writer
examples.description: Type a word and the QL spells it backwards using SuperBASIC string slicing, then uses the case-blind == comparison to spot a palindrome.

examples.title: Guess my number
examples.description: The QL thinks of a number from 1 to 100 and answers Higher or Lower until you find it, inside a named REPeat loop, SuperBASIC's structured alternative to GO TO.
